title: 第13章 我们一起去跟大师姐道歉第14章 没有做就完成的任务
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: 岳子舒昨天回来时见过林筱发飙怼全宗的场面，知道他这个师姐和原先不一样了，温以宁可没有。
在她印象里，林筱虽为大师姐，但性子比诗芷晴还软弱，平日里只一个人默默修炼，见人都是躲着走的。
今天她来也不是为了听林筱讲课的，而是怕有弟子欺负林筱，她在最起码还能为林筱出出头。
但她万万没想到会看到这样一幕！
刚刚那个气势爆棚的，真的是之前连去鉴宝阁买东西都要拉着她一起，不敢开口的大师姐吗？
不过，谁说这不是一个好的转变呢？
修真界本就是弱肉强食，靠宗门保护，靠别人保护永远都不如自身强大，自己保护自己来的实际，靠谱。
岳子舒和温以宁起身，并肩走出了讲堂。
温以宁偏头看向岳子舒，“二师兄，其实你今天来也是担心有人欺负大师姐，来替大师姐坐镇出头的对不对？”
岳子舒笑容不变，“我的师姐，总不能让他人欺负了。”
温以宁撇嘴，才不信他鬼话，“大师姐又不是只开过这一次讲座，之前你怎么不来？”
“不过，大师姐刚刚确实吓了我一跳，我不过闭关了几年时间，大师姐就跟换了一个人似的。”
“如果不是真的经历过什么，大师姐身上不可能会有那种煞气……”
温以宁越想越不对，”
不行，我去问问大长老，说不定他知道什么。”
温以宁朝大长老住所跑去，岳子舒则回想着方才林筱说过的那几句话。
那一句句，可不是胡言乱语，而是真正揭示修真界残酷本质的名言。
那些个弟子但凡能真的参透林筱话的十分之一，未来前途都不可限量。
想到林筱面无表情的脸，岳子舒眼里闪过一丝兴味。
他之所以来，替林筱出头是假，看戏是真。
林筱被欺负也好，欺负别人也罢，他都不会插手，他只是喜欢凑热闹，找乐子罢了。
方才发生的一切都在证明他来对了，而且他有种预感，接下来的日子，他可看的戏不会少。
讲堂内，没有笑林筱的人都万分庆幸管住了自己的嘴，悄悄从后门离开。
剩下的人都是保持着默契的沉默，谁也没有先开口。
直到一个人忍不住说道，“大师姐太过分了！
难道真要我们用凡人之体抄宗规一百遍吗？”
“你爱抄你们抄去，反正我不抄，天衍宗宗规足足四十九大款，六百四十五小款，抄一百遍我手不得废了，一个月都抄不完。”
“都是你！”
有弟子埋怨的看向黄夏夏，“大师姐好好讲课，你插什么话？”
“就是，如果不是你我们能惹大师姐生气吗？”
黄夏夏憋红了脸，“这怎么能怪我，是你们要笑的，我又没让你们笑。”
“呜呜，我错了，我不想抄书。”
“我去找大师姐认错，我以后认真修炼，对师姐师哥们恭恭敬敬的，我不想抄书。”
有人拉不下脸，“不是，你们有没有点骨气，要去你们去，我不去，我就不信，她不抄还能把我怎么样不成？”
“骨气有个屁用，大师姐平日里是懒得搭理我们，人家是太上长老弟子，跟太上长老说一句，赶几个人出宗不是轻轻松松？”
“我也去道歉，还有谁要一起吗？”
“我我！”
“我们所有人一起道歉，最起码能少抄一点吧，一百遍实在太多了。”
为了诚意足，有人不想去也被其他弟子逼着去了，就是黄夏夏也一样，哪怕她心里一百万个不愿意，但是那么多弟子都瞪着她，她一个金丹也心里发怵。
等所有弟子都离开后，没人注意到角落一个红衣少年撑着头饶有兴趣看了他们良久。
“呵，你们这天衍宗倒是有几个有意思的人。”
空气中响起一道带笑的男声。
如果有人在这里肯定会吓死，因为讲堂就少年一个人，少年没开口，那这道声音是谁的。
content_en:
When Yue Zishu came back yesterday, he saw Lin Xiao getting mad at the whole sect. He knew that his senior sister was different from before, and Wen Yining didn't want to be without her.
In her impression, although Lin Xiao was the senior sister, her temperament was even weaker than Shi Zhiqing's. She usually practiced silently alone and avoided everyone she saw.
She came today not to listen to Lin Xiao's lectures, but because she was afraid that some disciples would bully Lin Xiao. At the very least, she could stand up for Lin Xiao.
But she never expected to see such a scene!
Is the person who was full of momentum just now really the senior sister who had to drag her along before even going to the Treasure Appraisal Pavilion to buy things and didn't dare to speak?
But who says this isn't a good change?
The world of cultivation is originally about the weak and the strong, relying on the protection of the sect, and relying on the protection of others will never be as strong as oneself. Protecting oneself by oneself is practical and reliable.
Yue Zishu and Wen Yining stood up and walked out of the lecture hall side by side.
Wen Yining tilted her head and looked at Yue Zishu, "Second senior brother, actually you came today because you were worried that someone would bully Senior Sister, so you came to stand up for Senior Sister, right?"
Yue Zishu's smile did not change, "My senior sister, we can't let others bully us anymore."
Wen Yining curled her lips, not believing his nonsense, "Sister, it's not just this lecture. Why didn't you come before?"
"However, Senior Sister really shocked me just now. I have only been in seclusion for a few years, and Senior Sister seems to be a different person."
"If she hadn't really experienced something, it would be impossible for Senior Sister to have that kind of evil spirit..."
The more Wen Yining thinks about it, the more wrong he becomes."
No, I'll ask the great elder, maybe he knows something. "
Wen Yining ran towards the elder's residence, while Yue Zishu recalled what Lin Xiao had just said.
That sentence is not nonsense, but a famous saying that truly reveals the cruel nature of the world of cultivation.
As long as those disciples can truly understand one tenth of Lin Xiao's words, their future prospects will be unlimited.
Thinking of Lin Xiao's expressionless face, Yue Zishu's eyes flashed with interest.
The reason why he came was to stand up for Lin Xiao, which was fake, but to watch the show was real.
Whether Lin Xiao is being bullied or bullying others, he will not interfere. He just likes to join in the fun and have fun.
Everything that happened just now proved that he was right, and he had a hunch that there would be many dramas for him to watch in the coming days.
…
In the lecture hall, everyone who did not laugh at Lin Xiao was extremely glad that they kept their mouths shut and quietly left through the back door.
The rest of the people maintained a tacit silence, and no one spoke first.
Until one person couldn't help but said, "Sister, you are going too far!
Do we really need to use our mortal bodies to copy the sect’s rules a hundred times? "
"Copy it if you like, but I won't copy it anyway. The Tianyan Sect's rules are forty-nine major sections and six hundred and forty-five minor sections. If I copy them a hundred times, I won't be able to use up my hands. I won't be able to finish them in a month."
"It's all you!"
Some disciples looked at Huang Xiaxia complainingly, "Senior Sister, give a good lecture, what are you interrupting?"
"That's right, if it weren't for you, could we make Senior Sister angry?"
"I, I..."
Huang Xiaxia suppressed her blush, "How can you blame me? It's you who want to laugh, and I didn't let you laugh."
"Woo, I was wrong, I didn't want to copy the book."
"I will go to Senior Sister to admit my mistake. I will practice seriously in the future and be respectful to Senior Sister and Brother. I don't want to copy books."
Some people couldn't help but say, "No, do you have any backbone? If I want you to go, I won't believe it if I don't go. What else can she do to me if she doesn't copy it?"
"Spine is of no use. Senior sister is usually too lazy to talk to us. She is a disciple of the Supreme Elder. Let me tell the Supreme Elder, isn't it easy to drive a few people out of the sect?"
"I'm going to apologize too. Does anyone else want to come with me?"
"Me me!"
"We all apologize together. At least we can copy less. A hundred times is too much."
For the sake of sincerity, some people who didn't want to go were forced to go by other disciples. Even Huang Xiaxia was the same. Even though she had a million unwillingness in her heart, so many disciples were staring at her, and even she was afraid even if she was a golden elixir.
After all the disciples left, no one noticed that a young man in red in the corner looked at them with interest for a long time, holding his head.
"Heh, you Tianyan Sect has some interesting people."
A laughing male voice sounded in the air.
If anyone were here, they would definitely be scared to death, because the young man was the only one in the lecture hall, and the young man didn't speak, so who did this voice belong to.
title_en: Chapter 13 Let’s go and apologize to Senior Sister Chapter 14 Task completed without doing it
